name: taskfile
description:
The project configuration is at version 3. By default it runs in a development environment, with APP_ENV set to **development** and the system PATH inherited via `${PATH}`. The build artefacts are placed in the **bin** directory and the resulting executable is named **myapp**.  

The workflow defines four tasks. The **clean** task, described as “Remove generated binaries and temporary files”, executes `rm -rf {{.output_dir}}` followed by `rm -rf ./tmp`. The **build** task, “Compile the Go application”, depends on **clean** and runs `go build -o {{.output_dir}}/{{.binary_name}} ./cmd/{{.binary_name}}`; it sets the variables GOOS to linux and GOARCH to amd64. The **test** task, “Run unit and integration tests”, runs `go test ./... -v` silently, without echoing the command. Finally, the **run** task, “Build and execute the application”, depends on **build**, executes `{{.output_dir}}/{{.binary_name}}`, and overrides the environment to set APP_ENV to **production**.

clean.desc: Remove generated binaries and temporary files
